sql.attachmentType.getTypesForCompany: select at.*, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where company_id = :companyId and at.archived is not true and at.is_system is not true
sql.attachmentType.getAvailableTypesForProce: select at.* from flow.attachment_type at where at.archived is not true and at.company_id = :companyId and at.is_system is not true and not exists ( select process_step_id from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat where psat.attachment_type_id = at.id and psat.process_step_id = :id and archived is not true and at.is_system is not true ) order by at.attachment_type
sql.attachmentType.getAttachmentTypesForProj: select at.*, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where company_id = :companyId and at.archived is not true and at.is_system is not true and not exists ( select id from flow.project_attachment_type pat where pat.attachment_type_id = at.id and pat.archived is not true )
sql.attachmentType.getProcessStepType: SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.process_step_id as "processStepId", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.archived FROM flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.id = :id
sql.attachmentType.insertProcessStepType: insert into flow.process_step_attachment_type (attachment_type_id, process_step_id, created_by_id, date_created) values (:attachmentTypeId, :processStepId, :createdById, now())
sql.attachmentType.deleteProcessStepType: update flow.process_step_attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getType: select at.id, at.attachment_type, at.company_id, at.archived, at.key_pattern_id, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where at.company_id = :companyId and at.id = :typeId order by at.attachment_type;
sql.attachmentType.deleteType: update flow.attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.updateType: update flow.attachment_type set attachment_type = :attachmentType, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getProjectType: SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.company_id as "companyId", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.archived FROM flow.project_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getProjectTypes: SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.company_id as "companyId", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.archived FROM flow.project_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.company_id = :companyId and psat.archived is not true
sql.attachmentType.insertProjectType: insert into flow.project_attachment_type (attachment_type_id, company_id, created_by_id, date_created) values (:attachmentTypeId, :companyId, :createdById, now())
sql.attachmentType.deleteProjectType: update flow.project_attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
